TITLE: Step 1: Define the evaluation scope
INTRO: Define the overall parameters and scope of the evaluation. Ideally, this is done with the person who commissioned the evaluation (who may or may not be the product's owner), to align expectations.
INF_SITE_NAME:
Provide a name for the digital product that you would like to evaluate. For example:
  • “Webshop of Example Company”
  • “Public Website of Example Organization”
  • “Intranet of Example University”
INF_SITE_SCOPE_0: Define the scope of the digital product, so it's clear which views are included in the evaluation. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 1.1: Define the scope of the digital product](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step1a). For example:
INF_SITE_SCOPE_LI0: “All web content of the public website of Example Org. located at `https://www.example.org`”
INF_SITE_SCOPE_LI1: “All web content of the online shop of Example Org. located at `https://www.example.org/shop/`”
INF_SITE_SCOPE_LI2: “All web content of the mobile version of the public website of Example Org. located at `https://m.example.org`”
INFO_WCAG_VERSION: Select the WCAG version to use. Version 2.2 (default), 2.1, or 2.0
INF_CONF_TGT: Select a target WCAG 2 conformance level ('A', 'AA', or 'AAA') for the evaluation. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 1.2: Define the conformance target](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step1b). This selection determines which conformance level filters are active by default in “Step 4: Evaluate sample set”.
INF_SUPPORT_BASE: Define the web browsers, assistive technologies, and other [user agents](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#useragentdef) for which features provided on the digital product are to be [accessibility supported](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#accessibility-supporteddef). For example, “Edge with JAWS”, “FireFox with NVDA”, and “Safari with VoiceOver” could be basic definitions. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 1.3: Define an accessibility support baseline](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step1c).
INF_EXTRA_REQUIREMENTS_0: Define any additional evaluation requirements. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 1.4: Define additional evaluation requirements](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step1d). For example:
INF_EXTRA_REQUIREMENTS_LI0: “The report will include a list of all errors identified by the evaluator, rather than examples only”
INF_EXTRA_REQUIREMENTS_LI1: “The report will include a description of the problem and repair suggestions for any errors listed”
INF_EXTRA_REQUIREMENTS_LI2: “The evaluation will cover all views of the digital product, rather than a selected sample set only”
DATA_LOSS_WARNING: This change removes one or more evaluated criteria from the report. Your observations for these criteria will be deleted. Are you sure you want to continue?
